name: Google Business Profile
action: Claim a profile for Bona, Al Rawdah, Jeddah. Postcard or phone verification takes a few days.

name: Domain bona.com.sa
action: A .com.sa needs a Saudi CR or registered trade name. Register through a SaudiNIC-accredited registrar, then flip site.url and DNS.

name: Commercial registration
action: Issue the CR for Bona Real Estate on the Ministry of Commerce portal. Unlocks the domain, company FAL licence and bank account.

name: REGA FAL licence and ad licences
action: Apply for the company FAL licence, then an advertising licence per listing before any paid promotion.
detail: The site currently shows the owner's personal FAL licence 1100313556.

name: Email
action: No mailbox until bona.com.sa exists. Then Google Workspace or Zoho Mail on the domain; add the address to site.json.
